title: Known & Chosen
intro: Before there was a heartbeat, there was a knowing. Long before anyone could see you, God already had you in mind, already loved you, already called you His own. This first month we settle one thing deep in our hearts: this child is not an accident, but an intention.

keyScripture.text: Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, before you were born I set you apart.

weeks.title: Known Before You Were Formed
weeks.declaration: Little one, you were known before you were formed. You did not begin as a surprise to heaven; you began as a thought God had already been holding. This week we rest in that: you are known, and you are wanted.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, before we knew what to hope for, You already knew this child. Quiet our hearts this week. Let us carry expectation without anxiety, and trust You with what we cannot yet see. Amen.

weeks.title: Chosen on Purpose
weeks.declaration: Little one, you are chosen. Not chosen because of anything you have done, and not chosen by accident, but chosen on purpose by a God who does not make mistakes. Every part of you is wanted here.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, thank You for choosing this child and for choosing us to receive them. Steady us. Where we feel unready, be our readiness; where we feel afraid, be our peace. Amen.

weeks.title: Written in His Book
weeks.declaration: Little one, your days are already written. Before you have lived one of them, God has seen all of them, and He calls them good. Nothing about your story has been left to chance.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, You have written our child's days with kindness. Teach us to hold this life with open hands and full hearts, trusting the Author who has never written a careless line. Amen.

weeks.title: Made in Love
weeks.declaration: Little one, you are the work of God's own hands, and He works only in love. You are not being assembled; you are being crafted. Everything He is forming in you, He is forming with delight.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, You are making something beautiful, and we get to watch. Fill our home with peace this week. Let love, not fear, be the atmosphere this child grows in. Amen.

days.title: Known Before Time
days.declaration: Little one, before you were formed, you were known. God did not learn about you today; He has loved you from before there was time to count. We welcome you into a love that was already waiting.

scripture.text: Before I formed you in the womb I knew you.

days.title: Wanted
days.declaration: Little one, you are wanted. Not tolerated, not merely expected, but genuinely wanted. Today we declare over you that you belong here, and that your arrival is good news.
days.partner: Little one, I want you. Before I have held you, I am already glad you are coming. You belong here, and your arrival is good news in this house.

scripture.text: Children are a heritage from the Lord, offspring a reward from him.

days.title: No Accident
days.declaration: Little one, you are no accident. Heaven has been intentional about you from the very first moment. We speak away every shadow of doubt and declare that you arrived exactly on purpose.

scripture.text: He chose us in him before the creation of the world.

days.title: Called by Name
days.declaration: Little one, God already knows your name. Before we have chosen one, He has called you His own. You will never be a number or a stranger to Him.

scripture.text: I have summoned you by name; you are mine.

days.title: Written in the Book
days.declaration: Little one, all your days were written before one of them came to be. Today is one of them, and it is held. We thank God for a story already begun in kindness.

scripture.text: All the days ordained for me were written in your book before one of them came to be.

days.title: Loved First
days.declaration: Little one, you did not have to earn this love. You were loved before you could do anything at all, and that will never change. We declare over you a security that nothing can shake.

scripture.text: We love because he first loved us.

days.title: Rest in Being Known
days.declaration: Little one, you are fully known and fully loved at the same time. There is nothing to prove and nothing to hide. Today we rest, and we teach your heart to rest too.

scripture.text: You have searched me, Lord, and you know me.

days.title: Set Apart
days.declaration: Little one, you are set apart. God has marked out a place in this world that is yours, and no one else can fill it. We declare that you will never live a borrowed life.

scripture.text: Before you were born I set you apart.

days.title: Held in Thought
days.declaration: Little one, God's thoughts toward you are more than can be counted, and every one of them is good. You are on His mind today. We declare that you will always know you are thought of.

scripture.text: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is the sum of them!

days.title: A Good Plan
days.declaration: Little one, the plans over your life are plans for peace and not for harm. You are being carried into a future with hope in it. We refuse fear over your story today.

scripture.text: Plans to give you hope and a future.

days.title: Made in Love
days.declaration: Little one, you are being made by hands that only know how to love. Nothing about you is careless or rushed. We declare that you are crafted, not merely made.

scripture.text: You created my inmost being; you knit me together in my mother's womb.

days.title: Your Days Are Counted
days.declaration: Little one, not one of your days is unaccounted for. God has numbered them all and He has numbered them well. We declare length of days and fullness of life over you.

scripture.text: With long life I will satisfy him and show him my salvation.

days.title: Never Hidden
days.declaration: Little one, you are never out of sight. Even now, hidden from ours, you are in full view of God's. We declare that you will never be overlooked or forgotten.

scripture.text: My frame was not hidden from you when I was made in the secret place.

days.title: Welcomed
days.declaration: Little one, this family is glad about you. You are walking into open arms and a ready welcome. We declare that belonging will be the first thing you learn here.
days.partner: Little one, I am glad about you. You are walking into open arms, and I will be one of them. Belonging will be the first thing you learn from me.

scripture.text: And he took the children in his arms, placed his hands on them and blessed them.

days.title: The Beginning of You
days.declaration: Little one, something has begun that will never end. You are an eternal soul with a starting point but no finishing line. We thank God for the beginning of you.

scripture.text: The Lord God formed a man... and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life.

days.title: Life Speaks
days.declaration: Little one, life is speaking over you today and we agree with it. Every word spoken in this house about you will be a word of blessing. We choose our words for you carefully.

scripture.text: The tongue has the power of life and death.

days.title: Fearfully Made
days.declaration: Little one, you are fearfully and wonderfully made, and that is not a compliment but a fact. We declare that you will grow up sure of your own worth, because it was settled before you arrived.

scripture.text: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made.

days.title: A Quiet Miracle
days.declaration: Little one, the most extraordinary things God does are usually done quietly. You are one of them. We celebrate what no one can see yet.

scripture.text: Who dares despise the day of small things?

days.title: Grace Over Beginnings
days.declaration: Little one, grace covers your beginning. Whatever came before you, it does not define you, and it does not follow you. We declare a clean, kind start over your life.

scripture.text: His mercies are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.

days.title: Peace Over This House
days.declaration: Little one, we are making peace the climate you grow in. Not a house without trouble, but a house where God is trusted. We declare peace over the room you are being formed in.

scripture.text: You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast.

days.title: Joy Rising
days.declaration: Little one, you are already bringing joy, and you have not even arrived. We declare that gladness will follow you, and that you will be a reason people smile.

scripture.text: He will be a joy and delight to you, and many will rejoice because of his birth.

days.title: His Workmanship
days.declaration: Little one, you are God's handiwork, made for good things He prepared long ago. Your purpose is older than you are. We declare that you will find it and love it.

scripture.text: For we are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works.

days.title: Named in Heaven
days.declaration: Little one, heaven already recognises you. Before this world learns your name, it is known where it matters most. We declare that your identity will never depend on applause.

scripture.text: Rejoice that your names are written in heaven.

days.title: Rooted in Love
days.declaration: Little one, may love be the soil you grow in, deep and wide and unshakable. We declare that you will be rooted and established in love long before you can define it.

scripture.text: Being rooted and established in love.

days.title: Carried Already
days.declaration: Little one, you are being carried in more ways than one. God has upheld you from the moment you began, and He will not put you down. We declare that you are safe in His carrying.

scripture.text: You whom I have upheld since your birth, and have carried since you were born.

days.title: Light Over You
days.declaration: Little one, God's face is turned toward you and it is shining. We declare favour over your life, and a kindness that goes ahead of you into every room you will ever enter.

scripture.text: The Lord make his face shine on you and be gracious to you.

days.title: A Heritage
days.declaration: Little one, you are a gift and not a burden. You are a reward, not a cost. We declare that you will always know you were received as treasure.
days.partner: Little one, you are a gift to me and not a burden. I receive you as treasure, and I will make sure you always know it.

scripture.text: Children are a heritage from the Lord.

days.title: Sealed in His Keeping
days.declaration: Little one, we close this month by handing you back to the One who thought of you first. You are known, you are chosen, you are kept. We declare that nothing can take you out of His hand.

scripture.text: No one will snatch them out of my hand.
